purpose: Reconcile the inherited Documentation Truth drift introduced by the 2026-09-07 FCR Access front-door incident range without relabeling historical commits as reviewed or claiming live Cloudflare provider state.
reconciledInvariants: Provider truth is semantic: exactly one existing public Access application may be recognized as already-public-bypass only when the exact foundercontrolroom.org/* destination and Bypass / Everyone semantics are independently verified.
Rollback authority is identity-bound: a behaviorally equivalent non-managed application can support provider truth but must never become the workflow-managed rollback target.

Broader, multi-destination, worker, preview-worker, policy-ambiguous, or otherwise unresolved destination profiles remain manual-review blockers; public evidence may expose only bounded destination-shape/profile classifications rather than raw provider payloads or application IDs.
Public stranger reachability and founder-only control-plane containment are independent browser assertions; neither can substitute for the other.
Source and documentation reconciliation do not prove current Cloudflare provider configuration, provider mutation, deployed runtime identity, merge authority, deploy authority, or review authority.
historicalTruth: The listed incident commits remain historical direct-main facts. This reconciliation repairs present-tense operator documentation only and does not manufacture independent review provenance for that historical range.
